subject: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow
messages:
From: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@resellr.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Markus Engel <markus.engel@resellr.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're taking the draft marketplace addendum through our procurement and legal teams and need to lock two things before we can move to signatures:

1) Invoice ownership for marketplace sales — who is the bill-to and who is ultimately responsible for tax/invoicing (Resellr resells via cloud marketplace).
2) Evidence required for future auditing (revshare reconciliation and entitlement tracing).

Attached is our working copy of the addendum with inline comments (resellr-marketplace-addendum-draft.docx). Can you confirm Redwood's expected evidence package and whether Redwood will accept pass-through invoices plus entitlement exports as sufficient proof? If not, please list the minimum artifacts and the retention window you'd require.

We'd like to have this finalized by EOD Wednesday if possible to keep our marketplace onboarding on track.

Thanks,
Bethany
Procurement Lead | Resellr Inc.
Bethany Liu | bethany.liu@resellr.com

Attachment: resellr-marketplace-addendum-draft.docx (Word document, 14KB)

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@resellr.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow

Bethany — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the draft. Quick answers up front, then details below:

- Billing owner: Redwood invoices the end-customer when the sale is through Redwood we're contracting with the customer. For marketplace resales where Resellr is the seller of record we expect a pass-through billing model: Resellr invoices the customer and Redwood receives a pass-through settlement.
- Evidence package (minimum): signed Order Form/Proof of Purchase, chronological invoice trail (seller invoice + settlement records), entitlement/export of tenant IDs/activation timestamps, and a reconciliation report showing units/usage tied to invoice periods.
- Retention window: 24 months by default; 36 months if audit language is exercised in the MSA.

Proposed next steps: I've attached a short note that maps billing owner responsibilities and a proposed signer matrix we use internally for these addenda (redwood-billing-owners-v1.pdf, signer-matrix.xlsx). If legal wants tighter audit windows or escrow, loop in Laura (cc'd).

Two clarifying questions for your procurement team:
- Are marketplaces generating consolidated invoices for multi-tenant purchases, or does Resellr plan to forward individual invoices to end-customers?
- Will Resellr be able to provide a per-tenant entitlement export (CSV) as part of a quarterly reconciliation?

If you can confirm those two items by tomorrow midday we'll route a short redline back for signatures.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-billing-owners-v1.pdf (PDF, 9KB); signer-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 6KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@resellr.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow

Hi Bethany / team — looping in formal legal suggestions. High level: we can accept the pass-through billing model but need MSA-level protections and a short sequence in the addendum. Key redlines: 

- Insert section: "Marketplace Resale and Pass-Through Invoicing" that confirms seller of record responsibilities, tax indemnity carveout, and that Resellr must preserve invoice/settlement records for 24 months.
- Audit window: Redwood reserves the right to audit pass-through transactions up to 36 months post-invoice where material discrepancies are suspected (threshold to be defined in Exhibit A).
- Escrow/funds: For high-value settlements (> $250k per quarter) require temporary hold/backstop language while disputes are investigated.
- Data scope: entitlement exports must include tenant ID, SKU, activation timestamp; CSV schema attached.

I've attached an annotated redline for the addendum (laura-redlines.docx). Two asks for Resellr: please confirm whether marketplace SKUs include consumption-based charges (we need to align metering proofs) and confirm who will be the person of contact for audits.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: laura-redlines.docx (Word, 28KB)

From: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@resellr.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Markus Engel <markus.engel@resellr.com>, procurement@harpercloud.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow

Laura / Dylan — thanks for the speedy review and the concrete asks. Quick answers: 

- Resellr will be seller of record and will issue invoices to end-customers in the marketplace flow. We can provide per-tenant entitlement CSVs on a quarterly basis; we can also provide consolidated settlement records on request.
- Marketplaces in scope include both direct consolidated invoices and itemized tenant-level exports depending on the cloud partner. We'll confirm which marketplaces will default to consolidated invoices and annotate in Exhibit B.
- Audit contact: Markus Engel (CC'd) will own procurement and audit coordination on Resellr's side.

Attaching our procurement checklist and a short note on how Resellr's billing system exports the entitlement CSV (resellr-procurement-checklist.pdf). We can accept the 24-month retention and agree to 36 months where Redwood triggers an audit for reasonable suspicion. On escrow: we'll need to discuss thresholds — $250k/quarter is a bit high for our current run rate.

We can do a short call tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize redlines.

Best,
Bethany
Attachment: resellr-procurement-checklist.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Bethany Liu <bethany.liu@resellr.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing owner & evidence flow

Thanks everyone — solid progress and appreciate the responsiveness. Quick mutual action plan so we don't lose momentum: 

1) Dylan to incorporate Laura's redlines into the addendum and return a tracked draft to Resellr by EOD 27 Apr (Dylan).
2) Resellr to confirm which marketplaces will use consolidated vs per-tenant invoices and provide a sample entitlement CSV by EOD 28 Apr (Bethany / Markus).
3) Legal ping: Laura to propose Exhibit A audit threshold language and a short definition for "material discrepancy" by 29 Apr.
4) Ops: Karthik to prepare a short-run reconciliation template Redwood will use for quarterly reconciliations (output: CSV mapping invoice -> tenant -> usage) by 30 Apr.
5) Schedule: 10am PT call on 28 Apr to finalize any open items. If all looks good after the call, target DocuSign for signatures on 29 Apr.

I'll own the schedule and will send the calendar invite. Linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8812.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Quoted earlier: "Thanks again for the call this morning."
